uuid, workspace_uuid, message_batch_uuid, request_index, external_id, custom_id, params, status, result, upstream_request_id, started_at, completed_at, in_flight_worker_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_batches ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, api_variant, anthropic_version, beta_headers, request_count, processing_count, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.APIVariant}, #{params.AnthropicVersion}, CAST(#{params.BetaHeaders} AS jsonb), #{params.RequestCount}, #{params.RequestCount}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.ExpiresAt} ) RETURNING uuid, created_at, updated_at

INSERT INTO message_batch_requests ( external_id, workspace_uuid, message_batch_uuid, request_index, custom_id, params ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.MessageBatchUUID}, #{params.RequestIndex}, #{params.CustomID}, CAST(#{params.Params,sensitive=true} AS jsonb) )

INSERT INTO jobs (external_id, workspace_uuid, type, status, payload) VALUES ( CONCAT('job_', REPLACE(CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS text), '-', '')), #{workspaceUUID}, 'message_batch_process', 'pending', CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM message_batches mb
mb.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND mb.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (mb.created_at, mb.uuid) > (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
AND (mb.created_at, mb.uuid) < (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
ORDER BY mb.created_at DESC, mb.uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE message_batches SET processing_status = 'canceling', cancel_initiated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND processing_status = 'in_progress'
UPDATE message_batches SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND processing_status = 'ended'

UPDATE message_batches SET processing_status = 'ended', ended_at = #{params.EndedAt}, processing_count = #{params.Processing}, succeeded_count = #{params.Succeeded}, errored_count = #{params.Errored}, canceled_count = #{params.Canceled}, expired_count = #{params.Expired}, results_s3_bucket = #{params.ResultsBucket}, results_s3_key = #{params.ResultsKey}, results_size_bytes = #{params.ResultsSize}, results_sha256 = #{params.ResultsSHA256}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.BatchUUID} AND processing_status IN ('in_progress', 'canceling')

UPDATE message_batch_requests SET status = #{finalStatus}, result = CAST(#{result,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_batch_uuid = #{batchUUID} AND status = 'queued'

UPDATE message_batch_requests SET status = 'errored', result = CAST(#{result,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_batch_uuid = #{batchUUID} AND status = 'in_flight' AND started_at < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('queued', 'in_flight')) AS int) AS processing, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'succeeded') AS int) AS succeeded, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'errored') AS int) AS errored, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'canceled') AS int) AS canceled, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'expired') AS int) AS expired FROM message_batch_requests WHERE message_batch_uuid = #{batchUUID}

SELECT
FROM message_batches mb WHERE mb.deleted_at IS NULL AND mb.processing_status IN ('in_progress', 'canceling') AND mb.expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY mb.expires_at, mb.uuid LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM message_batch_requests WHERE message_batch_uuid = #{batchUUID} ORDER BY request_index
mapper.update: UPDATE message_batch_requests SET status = 'in_flight', started_at = #{startedAt}, in_flight_worker_id = #{workerID}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{requestUUID} AND status = 'queued'

UPDATE message_batch_requests SET status = #{params.Status}, result = CAST(#{params.Result,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), upstream_request_id = NULLIF(#{params.UpstreamRequestID}, ''), completed_at = #{params.CompletedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.RequestUUID} AND status = 'in_flight'

WITH next_jobs AS ( SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE type = 'message_batch_process' AND run_after <= NOW() AND ( status IN ('pending', 'retry') OR (status = 'running' AND locked_until < NOW()) ) ORDER BY run_after, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{workerID}, locked_until = NOW() + #{leaseMicroseconds} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond', updated_at = NOW() FROM next_jobs WHERE j.uuid = next_jobs.uuid RETURNING j.uuid, j.external_id, j.workspace_uuid, j.payload->>'message_batch_uuid' AS message_batch_uuid, COALESCE(j.payload->>'message_batch_external_id', '') AS message_batch_external_id, j.attempts

UPDATE jobs SET locked_until = NOW() + #{leaseMicroseconds} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond', updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND type = 'message_batch_process' AND status = 'running' AND locked_by = #{workerID}
UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND type = 'message_batch_process'

UPDATE jobs SET status = #{params.Status}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, run_after = #{params.RunAfter}, updated_at = NOW(), attempts = #{params.Attempts}, payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('last_error', CAST(#{params.Reason,sensitive=true} AS text)) WHERE uuid = #{params.JobUUID} AND type = 'message_batch_process'
